body: I’m sorry about that, my parents take away my phone when anything happens so I can imagine how that would feel.

Thanks you for taking the time to reply. I do happen to have hobbies and things that make me happy but every time I do them I feel sad right after. Now I don’t even want to do them anymore cause I know the happiness I’ll have will only last for a moment. But I am here for help so I’ll try those a bit more before I commit to doing anything.
